decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display, it fits the firm's core paper-based display know-how and can be refined through its in-house design and production capabilities.
This cardboard shelf display with pegboard back remains close to the firm's established display expertise, making customer feedback relatively easy to absorb and apply.
Although it overlaps with other quarter-pallet formats, it is a standard product squarely within the firm's existing knowledge base and manufacturing system.
The eighth-pallet cardboard display is another adjacent variant of the firm's main offer, so the firm is well placed to learn from early market use and improve it.
A wooden display pallet is materially and operationally less related to the firm's paper-display capabilities, so it offers weaker absorptive fit and fewer internal learning synergies.
Even if the media segment is somewhat niche, this product still builds on the firm's established quarter-pallet cardboard display competence and can be supported with existing resources.
